scope_note: The later differences are partial-remission results from this single pragmatic trial. More than 25% of primary-outcome data were missing at 42 months, and the result must not be generalized to all psychodynamic therapies or all patients.
statement: TADS found no significant partial-remission difference at treatment end, but reported significantly higher partial remission for the LTPP group at 24, 30, and 42 months.
statement_zh: TADS 在療程結束時未發現部分緩解率有顯著差異，但在第 24、30、42 個月回報長期精神分析取向心理治療組的部分緩解率顯著較高。
